credits_spent: free plan; publishing requires a paid plan
failures: L5: The site never goes live on the free plan. The public URL shows 'Preview mode — this website isn't live yet', and the dashboard says 'Upgrade now to launch a professional site'.
L3: The contact form has name, email, treatment and time fields, but submitting produces no confirmation and no error — the visitor cannot tell whether anything was sent.
L8: The footer shows '+1 234 567 8900' and 'email@mybusiness.com' as contact details.

artifacts.label: Landing page with the preview banner

notes: Fastest run of all: five minutes from signup to a generated page, no company data needed, no credit card. The content is good and includes all three prices. Two serious problems: the page cannot be published without a paid plan, so the URL stays in preview mode; and Durable invented four customer testimonials with names and job titles ('Elena M., Valletta resident', 'James T., Architect, Sliema' and so on) that nobody ever wrote. A new site owner who publishes that would be publishing fabricated reviews. The contact details are also placeholders (+1 234 567 8900, email@mybusiness.com). Scored against all eight landing criteria after the spec was aligned to the same eight-point scale as the booking tests.

criterion_notes.L9: Follow-up prompt changed the 90-minute price from $130 to $120 in the editor; other sections untouched. Publishing is still blocked by the paid plan.

retest.prompt: Change the price of the 90-minute massage from $130 to $120 on my website. Change nothing else.
retest.note: The AI Partner edited the home and services pricing. Verified in the editor only: Durable still refuses to publish on the free plan, so the change cannot be checked on a public URL.
